summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) filed a 6-K announcing a spin-off (Phase 2) of its Wholesale Fiber Connectivity business to PT Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia (TIF), a 99.9%-owned subsidiary. The transaction is a material affiliated transaction exceeding 20% of equity, but exempt from appraiser and shareholder approval under POJK 17/2020 given >99% ownership. No financial terms, valuation, or premium disclosed. The spin-off transfers partial assets and liabilities, with regulatory compliance under Indonesian company law and OJK. Watch for shareholder/investor reaction to the internal restructuring and any subsequent TIF capital-raising or IPO.
